items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was someone named Ken Macomber. Do you know that name?

ctx.x: That was in their early, really early period, and then first Don Redmond did the bulk of Henderson’s arrangements, and then . . .
Yes, yes. But there were a couple of other arrangers, too. There was someone named Ken Macomber. Do you know that name?
